editorial:
Imagine working for a total diva of a movie star who treats you like a doormat. That is exactly the nightmare you get into as the assistant to the charming but demanding movie star in this flick. Things go from bad to worse when you realize your boss is actually falling for your mom. It is a messy, awkward situation that feels like a classic rom-com setup. The movie has a bright, sunny vibe and focuses on the funny tension between a daughter who wants respect and a mother who is rediscovering her spark through a whirlwind romance.

Nicole Kidman and Zac Efron have great chemistry, though the plot stays pretty safe and predictable. You will probably find yourself laughing at the cringe-worthy moments more than the actual jokes. If you are looking for something light to relax with, this is a great pick. It is the kind of story that does not require much thinking, making it perfect for a lazy weekend.
endingExplained: After plenty of fighting and misunderstandings, the daughter finally accepts that her mother deserves to be happy. The movie wraps up with the movie star proving he has actually changed his selfish ways. He stops treating his assistant like a servant and starts treating her with real respect. The couple stays together, and the family finds a new, healthy balance. It ends on a sweet note where everyone learns how to communicate better.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted romantic comedies and family drama.
